title: Grimling settings
description: ~/.claude/grimling/settings.json. Every key is optional and has a default; a bad value keeps its default and shows as a problem in the pane (footer and the Keys tab). Keep in step with hooks/settings.ts.

time.description: How clock times show: plan-limit resets and kill-by times.

zone.description: "system" or an IANA time zone such as "Europe/Berlin".

showUtc.description: Show the UTC time first: 03:15Z (23:15 EDT).

grim.description: Grim, the mascot. The v0.4 form true/false still works as grim.enabled.

waiting.description: Grim pops up when an agent starts waiting.

lines.description: Your own lines per event (empty: the built-in ones). Placeholders: {name} {type} {duration} {task}.

notify.description: What happens when an agent finishes, fails or is stopped. Grim has its own switch (grim.enabled).

desktop.description: Also send a desktop notification through your notification channel.

cards.description: Card sources, an earlier one winning a shared name: built-ins, the mod's own agents, each pack, project agent files, user agent files. A project file may set it.

builtins.description: Scout, Builder, Planner, Fetcher and Guide.

packs.description: Agent packs: a folder with agents/*.md, optional agents/dex.json and templates/*.md. Its cards show as <ns>:<name>; ns defaults to the folder's .claude-plugin/plugin.json name. Enable the folder as a plugin too, or its cards cannot start. A relative path is read from the project folder.

hide.description: Card ids (scout, swarm, agent-<name>) or agent types to leave out.

size.description: Grimoire card size in the docked deck. auto: the largest size at which every shown card fits (full, then compact, then mini; past mini, a "N more" line). z cycles it for the session. Live agent cards are always full.

templates.description: Prompt templates: cards that fill the prompt instead of starting an agent. A project file may set it; a project's templates are tagged proj.

enabled.description: Template ids that get a card. <id>.md is looked up in the mod's templates/, each pack's templates/, ~/.claude/grimling/templates/ and the project's .claude/grimling/templates/; the last found wins.

pods.description: Pod status files (not part of the public v0.1.0).

enabled.description: auto: the Pods tab shows only while a status file is read.

files.description: Paths; a * in the file name matches.

arena.description: The Arena. Only your own settings.json may set these; a project file cannot.

model.description: The model both fighters run on: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a model id.

puzzlesFile.description: A JSON list of { id, title, question, answer, accept? } added to the built-in puzzles (same id replaces). ~ is your home; a relative path is read from ~/.claude/grimling. A project file cannot set it.

log.description: The run log under ~/.claude/grimling/runs/ (one file a day) and debug.log. A project file cannot set it.

runs.description: full: prompts and answers as sent (capped); redacted: the same with keys and tokens replaced by [redacted]; meta: no prompt, answer or task text; off: nothing written.

maxBytes.description: Size of one log file before the next part starts.

keepDays.description: Older day files are no longer read.

redact.description: Extra regular expressions to redact, on top of the built-in list.

debug.description: What goes to debug.log: every press and focus move, only errors, or nothing.

sessionsFile.description: A file holding {"n": <active sessions>} for the meter; off by default.

agentDex.description: Read by the agent-dex skill, not by the pane. A project file cannot set it.

rulesBlock.description: The rules block the skill ends every saved agent with. null: the skill's generic rules.

afterSave.description: One extra step the skill does after saving, in plain words (for example: add a line to a notes file). null: no extra step.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repo that /grimling-feedback opens an issue on.

nudge.description: One feedback hint after the 5th launch.

enabled.description: x / STOP on running cards the deck launched (asks Stop / Keep first, then TaskStop through the permission check). false hides the button.

arrows.description: Arrow keys move the focus ring around the docked pane: Up and Down between rows (keeping the column), Left and Right within a row (needs the keybinding in docs/SETTINGS.md). Tab is unchanged. false: arrows behave as before.
